answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust opal shield against Sybil entities by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. An attacker must possess a significant tide of wealth to control consensus, effectively pricing out malicious actors. In this secure lagoon of decentralized validation, the cost of an attack is tied directly to the value of the staked assets, ensuring that unauthorized identity proliferation is economically irrational and computationally prohibitive for any adversary.
